# github-linguist

**Tag**: filesystem

## 简介

We use this library at GitHub to detect blob languages, highlight code, ignore binary files, suppress generated files in diffs, and generate language breakdown graphs.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/github-linguist/9.7.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/github-linguist
